notation:
# Snowflake reference for pointed loops (SPEC_NOTES N6/P8) and the seam rule N7: the "Lacy hexagon"
# preset of the snowflake designer. Not a canonical fixture: only its spring network (and one growth placement) is pinned, lab vs app.
title: Lacy hexagon snowflake
terms: US
yarn: thread-10
hook: 1.5mm
params: thread-10_1.5mm
source: generated by the snowflake designer (guided, 6 points)
license: CC0-1.0

Rnd 1: ch 10, join to form ring, ch 4 (counts as dc, ch 1), *dc in ring, ch 1* x11, join. (12 dc, 12 ch-1 sps)
Rnd 2: sl st in next ch-1 sp, ch 1, sc in same sp, ch 2, *sc in next ch-1 sp, ch 2* x11, join. (12 sc, 12 ch-2 sps)
Rnd 3: sl st in next ch-2 sp, ch 1, sc in same sp, ch 3, *sc in next ch-2 sp, ch 3* x11, join. (12 sc, 12 ch-3 sps)
Rnd 4: sl st in next ch-3 sp, ch 1, (sc, ch 10, ch-4 picot, ch 10, sc) in same sp, ch 8, sk next ch-3 sp, *(sc, ch 10, ch-4 picot, ch 10, sc) in next ch-3 sp, ch 8, sk next ch-3 sp* x5, join, fasten off. (12 sc, 6 picot, 6 ch-8 sps, 12 ch-10 sps)
